findings.check: agent accepted a conflict it was shown
findings.what: e117's agent said yes to 2026-10-31/g1 although code told it: It runs to 9pm or later, and Ava avoids late nights.
findings.why: The agent is meant to check the plan against its person's profile; this yes ignores a conflict it was handed.
findings.expected: No, or a counter that removes the conflict, unless the agent explains why it doesn't apply.
findings.fix: Tighten the agent prompt, or have code refuse a yes that contradicts a hard check.
